summary: Full end-to-end testing of Alderly elder care platform. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed covering auth (register/login/me), catalogs (services, plans), bookings CRUD, mock subscription checkout, reminders, dashboard, callbacks. Frontend: 11/11 UI flows passed - landing page with 6 service cards + footer, signup->dashboard, login success + wrong-password error visible via data-testid=login-error, booking flow submits and appears on dashboard, route protection redirects to /login, mock subscription (six_month) activates and shows on dashboard, add reminder saves and displays, logout returns nav to Sign In/Get Started. Only minor observation: /services page doesn't expose testid prefix 'service-card-' but visually renders all 6 services correctly.

issues: Service cards on /services page do not carry the 'service-card-<slug>' data-testid prefix that landing page uses (they render visually, but automated selectors that assume this prefix return 0). Consider standardising testid naming.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers.
CORS: allow_origins defaults to '*' when CORS_ORIGINS unset; explicit origin list recommended for production even though credentials are disabled.
No password strength enforcement beyond min length 6; consider stronger validation.
No rate limiting/lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions brute-force lockout after 5 fails) — not implemented.
Bookings/reminders/subscriptions have no update/delete endpoints; if UX needs cancellation, add them.
Subscription check does not verify existing active plan before allowing another purchase (mock ok, but note for real payments).
seed_data_creation: Created qa_user_<timestamp>@alderly.in via signup and TEST_-prefixed bookings/reminders/subscriptions on testuser account during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features pass. Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 14 tests, 100% pass in ~3s). Auth is Bearer token (localStorage key 'alderly_token'). Playbook items NOT implemented: brute-force lockout, httpOnly cookies (this app deliberately uses Bearer tokens per problem statement). Note the note on /services testid naming inconsistency if standardisation is desired.
